events.metaDescription: The party, ready, with your child as the star: a WhatsApp invitation, printable decorations and a mini storybook for every guest.
events.title: The party, ready, with your child as the star
events.subtitle: A WhatsApp invitation, printable decorations and a party-favor storybook for the guests, all with the same character.
events.note: You can see how it looks without an account. We only ask you to sign in to save or download.

1.title: Pick the theme (1 minute)
1.text: And the birthday child's name. With or without a photo.

2.title: See the free sample
2.text: We design the character and its mini storybook, and you approve it before paying.

3.title: Download instantly
3.text: Print at home or at the print shop you prefer, as many copies as guests.

1.q: Does each guest get a different story?
1.a: No: everyone gets the same mini storybook, approved by you. That is faster and cheaper.

2.q: How do I print and assemble it?
2.a: Everything comes as a print-ready PDF for home or the print shop you prefer. Afterwards you can order printed invitations and thank-yous shipped to your home.

3.a: No. You can choose the character's features without uploading any photo.

4.a: Since it is digital, you download the files instantly. Order a few days ahead so you can print the pieces wherever you like.

5.q: How many copies can I print?
5.a: The number you choose when buying, up to 200 per piece. The quantity does not change the price.

professionals.disclaimer: StoryNido offers supportive stories. It is not a clinical system, does not replace professional judgment, and never asks for diagnoses or clinical records.

1.q: Can I create stories for different children?
1.a: Yes. Each story is an independent project in your account, identified by an alias.

2.q: Do I need photos of the children?
2.a: No. We recommend no-photo mode. If you use a photo, you need permission from the parent or guardian.

3.q: Can I match the text to the child’s level?
3.a: Yes: you choose the amount of text and the reading level, independently of the book’s length.

4.a: Yes, for repeat purchases from your account. We’ll publish the details when payments are enabled.

5.a: Yes. Before paying you can change the text of each page in the preview and regenerate that page’s illustration.

6.a: No. You pay for each story and, if you make many, your account gets volume discounts. For clinics and institutions that need larger quantities, write to us from Contact.
